Stimulate

STIM-yuh-layt — contains 'stimulus,' something that triggers action; to stimulate is to provide that trigger. · verb

Hear It

What It Means

To stimulate to encourage action, growth, or development.

The museum's new hands-on exhibits were designed to stimulate children's curiosity about science.

Worked Example

A teacher notices her students growing bored during a lecture, so she switches to a hands-on experiment. Within minutes, hands are raised everywhere, and students who were silent moments before are eagerly asking questions.

Sparking new energy, interest, or activity where there was none before is exactly what it means to stimulate something. Unlike 'inform,' which just means giving information, to stimulate means actively triggering activity or growth.

How Stimulate Sits Among Its Neighbors

Synonyms — open each to see how it differs

encourage

encourage: to give support or confidence to help something happen

boost

boost: to increase or improve something

trigger

trigger: to cause something to start happening

Antonyms

suppress

suppress: to prevent something from happening or growing

discourage

discourage: to make something less likely to happen

How Strong Is It? — encourage → stimulate → ignite

encourage vs. stimulate

encourage vs. stimulate: Encourage is a plainer, weaker word than stimulate — encouraging just offers support, while stimulating actively triggers new growth or activity.

ignite vs. stimulate

ignite vs. stimulate: Ignite can feel even more powerful than stimulate: to stimulate is to spark growth or interest, but to ignite means to set off something sudden, intense, and hard to stop.

Build the Word

The pieces

root — -stimul-

root — -stimul-: goad, prod (Latin)

suffix — -ate

suffix — -ate: to make or do (Latin)

Put it together

Put it together: Latin stimulare comes from stimulus, a pointed stick used to drive animals forward. To stimulate something is, at its root, to goad or prod it into new activity.

Use the root in a new word: stimulus

Use the root in a new word: stimulus: A loud noise can act as a stimulus that makes a sleeping cat instantly jump up.
